overview.title: From visual understanding to physical action
paragraphs: Agriculture-Vision brings computer vision research into conversation with the challenges of agriculture. The proposed eighth edition focuses on spatial intelligence and embodied AI: how machines can understand agricultural environments and use that understanding to act within them.

From crop monitoring to robotic harvesting and autonomous navigation, agricultural systems must work with complex plant structures, occlusion, and changing field conditions. The proposed research scope connects 3D representations, multimodal learning, and robotics with these practical challenges.

speakers.title: Confirmed invited speakers
speakers.intro: Participation is subject to workshop acceptance. Talk titles and times will be announced once finalized.

research.title: Spatial intelligence in the field
research.intro: The proposed scope spans computer vision methods and their use in agriculture.

areas.title: Understanding agricultural spaces
areas.text: Spatial intelligence, 3D scene representations and world models, including neural radiance fields and Gaussian splatting; analysis of agricultural imagery across space and time.

areas.title: Connecting perception to action
areas.text: Embodied AI, vision-language-action models, and transfer from simulation to real agricultural environments, connecting visual understanding with robotic systems.

areas.title: Learning across data and environments
areas.text: Multimodal foundation models, sensor and data fusion, and resources and benchmarks for agricultural vision, alongside other novel applications in agriculture.

research.note: Program and participation details will be announced after workshop acceptance.
